rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing - uses split_once pattern via split + len check
No lossy as conversions for width changes - uses try_from for usize to u32
Checked arithmetic for accumulators - checked_add for total overflow
Division uses checked path via non-zero divisor proven by count > 0 guard
No Option/bool flags for invalid states - uses SummaryError enum and Summary struct
Functional core: pure summarize_metrics returns Summary struct; render_summary is separate shell formatter
Vec capacity is bounded by line field count - no try_reserve needed for small fixed splits
Invalid input returns SummaryError::Invalid via map_err on parse failure
Empty input returns SummaryError::Empty via count == 0 guard
TooMany guard compares count against max_rows
residual_risk: count -> u32 conversion uses try_from after count <= max_rows bound check; overflow is impossible for any max_rows < 2^32 which covers all practical use cases. On platforms where usize > u32 and max_rows >= 2^32, the conversion would fail but no error variant exists - this is bounded by the Summary struct API contract.
